parameters.name: ConnectionStatus
parameters.description:
The endpoint connection status. Valid values:

- **Pending**: being modified.

- **Connecting**: connecting.

- **Connected**: connected.

- **Disconnecting**: disconnecting.

- **Disconnected**: disconnected.

- **Deleting**: being deleted.

- **ServiceDeleted**: the corresponding endpoint service has been deleted.

parameters.name: EndpointOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the account to which the endpoint belongs.

parameters.name: EniId
parameters.description: The endpoint elastic network interface (ENI) ID.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **1000**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include a token for the next query. Valid values:
- Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the endpoint connections to query.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~120468~~) to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ReplacedResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service resource that is replaced in a smooth migration of EPS resource scenario.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID of the endpoint to query.
